name: postman-book-verification
description: Re-runs the code examples from the Postman book against a local stand-in API

scripts.test: node build.js && newman run verify.postman_collection.json -e verify.postman_environment.json -d data.csv -n 1 --env-var clientSecret=s3cret -r cli,junit,slacksummary --reporter-junit-export out/junit.xml --reporter-slacksummary-export out/summary.md
